snippet.title: Dune Awakening - Exclusive Developer Interview - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
Based on the hit movie franchise and sci-fi novel by Frank Herbert, Dune Awakening lets players stray from the path of Paul Atreides and forge their own destiny on the planet of Arrakis. Here's an exclusive interview with the developers on what players can expect from Dune Awakening - which is out now on PlayStation, Xbox Series and PC. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #duneawakening
